verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a vendor-maintained catalog of 1,000+ integrations, including cloud services such as Alibaba Cloud and Amazon API Gateway and an 'Agent Metrics' integration. Its docs index covers infrastructure monitoring, and it offers Kubernetes-focused products like Kubernetes Autoscaling and Universal Service Monitoring. A community user reports metrics and traces were easier to collect than with alternatives, while another notes trace collection was resource-intensive and setup was difficult. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on host and container Agent installation, a dedicated Kubernetes/container monitoring setup page, independent hands-on corroboration of agent rollout across hosts/containers/K8s.
